    // The matrix with rows and columns exchanged.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transpose
    Transpose(self: Matrix4x4): Matrix4x4
        => (Number4(self.Row1.X, self.Row2.X, self.Row3.X, self.Row4.X),
            Number4(self.Row1.Y, self.Row2.Y, self.Row3.Y, self.Row4.Y),
            Number4(self.Row1.Z, self.Row2.Z, self.Row3.Z, self.Row4.Z),
            Number4(self.Row1.W, self.Row2.W, self.Row3.W, self.Row4.W));
